AdminView.title: Users and Companies
AdminView.subtitle: Who can log in, what they may do, and in which company

common.unsavedChangesText: There are unsaved changes. Really close?

overview.intro: Central administration of your installation. Users log in, groups bundle rights, companies are separate databases (tenants).
overview.howItWorksText: A user only sees a company when assigned to it. Rights come from groups — and a group only takes effect in a company it is assigned to as well. Creating a user handles all of this in one dialog.
overview.healthOk: All good — every user has access and rights, every company has users.

checks.usersWithoutCompany: {count} user(s) without a company — cannot log in anywhere
checks.usersWithoutGroup: {count} user(s) without a group — no rights after login
checks.usersWithoutPassword: {count} user(s) without a password — login impossible
checks.companiesWithoutUsers: {count} company/companies without users — nobody can log in there
checks.groupsWithoutCompany: {count} group(s) without a company — the rights have no effect
checks.noDefaultCompany: No default company set — the login screen preselects the first company otherwise
checks.usersWithDefaultPassword: {count} user(s) still using the default password ("{login}") — please change it

overview.legacyModeTitle: Transition mode: administrators derived from the "admin" right
overview.legacyModeText: No user has been explicitly marked as system administrator yet. Until then, every user holding the k9o right "admin" in any group counts as administrator. Decide now who may really administer — afterwards only this flag counts.
overview.legacyModeDone: You are now explicitly a system administrator.
overview.yourAccessExplicit: You are marked as system administrator.
overview.yourAccessSettings: You are listed as administrator in settings.ini.
overview.yourAccessLegacy: You provisionally count as administrator via the "admin" right.
overview.authDbHint: Holds users, groups and the list of companies — compatible with k9o.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Users log in with a login name and password. Which companies they see and what they may do is set here.
users.deleteText: The user will no longer be able to log in. Their documents and entries in the companies are kept and still show their name.

errors.LOGIN_EXISTS: This login name is already taken.
errors.CANNOT_DELETE_SELF: You cannot delete your own user.
errors.CANNOT_DEMOTE_SELF: You cannot revoke your own administrator role.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The user no longer exists — reloading the list.

users.defaultPassword: Default password from the installation — please change it

userDialog.name: Full name
userDialog.passwordHintNew: At least 8 characters. Tip: generate one and hand it to the user.
userDialog.adminHint: May manage users, groups and companies and create new company databases. Not needed for daily work.
userDialog.adminSelfHint: You cannot revoke this role from yourself — another administrator has to do that.
userDialog.companiesHint: The user can log in to these companies and is created there as an employee automatically.
userDialog.groupsHint: Rights come from groups. A group only takes effect in companies it is assigned to as well.
userDialog.noCompaniesWarning: Without a company the user cannot log in anywhere.
userDialog.noGroupsWarning: Without a group the user has no rights after login.
userDialog.groupNotInCompany: has no effect in any of the selected companies

groups.title: Groups
groups.intro: A group bundles rights. Members receive these rights in every company the group is assigned to.
groups.deleteText: Members lose the rights of this group. Users and companies are kept.
groups.emptyHint: Create a group, e.g. "Full access" or "Workshop".
groups.notInAnyCompany: Not assigned to any company — the rights have no effect

errors.GROUP_NAME_EXISTS: This group name is already taken.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The group no longer exists — reloading the list.

groupDialog.name: Name
groupDialog.descriptionHint: What is the group for? Helps when assigning later.
groupDialog.membersHint: These users receive the rights of the group.
groupDialog.companiesHint: The group's rights only apply in these companies.
groupDialog.noCompaniesWarning: Without a company the rights have no effect.

companies.title: Companies
companies.intro: Each company (tenant) has its own database with customers, documents and accounting. Users and groups are assigned per company.
companies.testOkNoOserp: Connection OK, but the OSERP tables are still missing. Please run "Bring database up to date".
companies.emptyHint: Create the first company — with a new database or from an existing one.
companies.deleteText: The company disappears from the login screen. The database stays and can be reconnected any time — unless you explicitly delete it as well.
companies.deleteDropHint: All customers, documents and bookings of this company will be deleted.
companies.deleteConfirmLabel: Type the database name to confirm
companies.deleteBackupHint: A compressed database dump is stored in the server's backup directory.
companies.dropFailed: Company removed, but the database could not be deleted: {error}

errors.COMPANY_NAME_EXISTS: This company name is already taken.
errors.DATABASE_ALREADY_REGISTERED: This database is already assigned to another company.
errors.DATABASE_EXISTS: A database with this name already exists on the server.
errors.NOT_A_COMPANY_DATABASE: This is not a company database (tables defaults/employee missing).
errors.CANNOT_DELETE_CURRENT: The company you are currently logged in to cannot be removed. Please switch to another company first.
errors.CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: The database name you entered does not match.
errors.BACKUP_FAILED: Backup failed — the database was NOT deleted.
errors.CANNOT_DROP_AUTH_DB: The auth database cannot be deleted.
errors.SCHEMA_ERROR: The database could not be set up.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The company no longer exists — reloading the list.

companyDialog.groupsHint: Without a group nobody has rights in this company.
companyDialog.creatingHint: Creating the database, loading the chart of accounts, adding OSERP tables. This takes about a minute — please keep this window open.
companyDialog.existingSelectHint: Only databases that look like a company database and are not yet assigned to a company
companyDialog.existingManual: Enter credentials manually (other server or user)

companyDialog.noUnregistered: There are no further company databases on the server that are not connected yet.
